full_judgment: 2. Short facts are that the pre-emptor instituted Miscellaneous Case No.I94 of 1972 under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act. 1950 in the First Court of Assistant Judge Laximpur claiming pre-emption of the case land. The contention of the petitioner is that he is a co-sharer by inheritance in the case holding. The opposite party No.2 transferred the case land to the opposite party No.1 by kabala dated 20.06.1972 for a consideration of Tk.400/-. The pre-emptor is not a co-sharer in respect of the land of Khatian Nos.1965 and 1989 as shown in schedule "Ka" to the misc. petition. The pre-emptor is therefore entitled to pre-empt '/ decimals of land in the "Kha" schedule only. No notice of the kabala under pre-emption was served upon the pre-emptor as co-sharer. She for the first time came to learn about kabala under pre-emption on 24.11.1972 after getting certified copy of the same and filed the case within time.
